shots.detail_en: Hook close-up: a cha chaan teng table, Hongli slides an old photo across to Chang Hong — face down (EP012 hook pays off)
shots.sub: 红："盘完了你的账，现在盘我的。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Chang Hong flips the photo — two fathers at the exchange gate; in the back corner stands young Xiong Tiancheng (three-way bond first fully shown)
shots.sub: 长："这不是照片。这是当年的开盘图——谁站多头，谁站空仓。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: handwriting on the photo back — 'Zhenhai & Jianguo, June '93, to the future'
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli points at a blurred child dashing past the frame edge (childhood Hongli); the backdrop is the Lianhua old-hall rooftop entrance
shots.sub: 红："93年6月17号，我爸在场。他回家烧了三天账本。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong's hand trembles around the photo — first time in ten years his emotion shows
shots.sub: 长："那天……在场的人，还有谁？"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Hongli shakes her head, takes out her father's ledger remnant — half a burnt order slip glued to it (imagery only, no content visible)
shots.sub: 红："爸只留了这个。他说——'欠振海兄一条命'。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: 1993 flashback: behind rain-streaked window glass, child Hongli watches her father carry armfuls of ledgers into a fire basin (back and flames only)
shots.sub: 童年红利（画外）："爸，你在烧什么呀？"
shots.speaker: 童年红利

shots.detail_en: Montage: the two fit photo, ledger page and prediction slip together on the table — edges meeting like assembling one complete candlestick chart
shots.sub: 旁白："账拼到一半，雨就停在了1993年6月17日。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Chang Hong turns the photo face-up and slides it back to her solemnly
shots.sub: 长："照片你留着。账我认——你帮我，不是恩情，是交易。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Twist two-shot: Hongli rises to leave, then stops, back turned to him
shots.sub: 红："交易可以。但有一条你别想错——我不是帮你。我是还我家的账。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Explosive close-up: Hongli lays down her bottom card — a filled-out, unsubmitted transfer application: 'Chief Analyst position'
shots.sub: 红："我帮你，用我的眼睛。你带我——看见我爸没敢看完的那场行情。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Wide: neon lights up outside the window, the two sit facing each other in silhouette (first side-by-side frame)
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: outside the glass Man Cang hugs three milk teas, moved to tears watching them, and headbutts the ice chest by the door
shots.sub: 满："这杯敬盘！这杯敬账！这杯……敬我全仓的命！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong smiles faintly for the first time in the whole series (age 22, growth beat)
shots.sub: 长："满仓，明天开始，你学止损。" 满（喷奶茶）："学什么？！"
shots.speaker: CH/MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli extends her hand formally
shots.sub: 红："合作愉快，陆先生。" 长（握手）："叫长虹。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: leaving the shop, Chang Hong hands Hongli an umbrella; she looks up — clear sky
shots.sub: 红："晴天递伞？" 长："这城的行情，说变就变。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Night surveillance room: Xiong Wei replays a black-and-white monitor feed of the two framed together (mechanical tone)
shots.sub: 熊伟："数据告诉我们：样本，开始集群。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Close-up of Xiong Wei's screen: red boxes light one by one over Chang Hong's account, Hongli's staff ID, Man Cang's account — then he tags them 'hold — do not mark'
shots.sub: 熊伟（画外）："先让他们长。样本越长，模型越准。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng's office: the assistant delivers the kraft report from EP10; he opens the first page and his smile freezes for an instant
shots.sub: 熊："哦……原来他姓陆。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Suspense close-up: the report header reads only '1993-Lu', the rest covered by Xiong's palm
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："查清来历的，不止一个人。而满仓的存折，已经揣了三天。"
shots.card: 查清来历的，不止一个人。而满仓的存折，已经揣了三天。
